Class MicronautRunnerJdkAotCache

java.lang.Object
org.gradle.api.internal.AbstractTask
org.gradle.api.DefaultTask
io.micronaut.runner.gradle.MicronautRunnerJdkAotCache
All Implemented Interfaces:
Comparable<org.gradle.api.Task>, org.gradle.api.internal.DynamicObjectAware, org.gradle.api.internal.TaskInternal, org.gradle.api.Named, org.gradle.api.plugins.ExtensionAware, org.gradle.api.Task, org.gradle.util.Configurable<org.gradle.api.Task>
@DisableCachingByDefault(because="JDK AOT caches are not byte-reproducible and are tied to the exact JDK build and to file modification times") public abstract class MicronautRunnerJdkAotCache extends org.gradle.api.DefaultTask
Trains a JDK AOT cache for the Runner JAR and verifies it: stages the program in its output directory (the extracted layout, or a copy of the Runner JAR), records a training run with the project's toolchain, creates the cache, and runs the verification gate. The directory then holds everything a cached deployment needs, and the application launches from it as java @app.jvmopts -jar <jar>.

The task is tracked: with the same Runner JAR, JDK build and settings it is up to date. It is never cached, and it is part of assemble only with jdkAotCache.enabled = true. It is experimental and belongs to this interim plugin only.

Since:
1.0
